message: I think the Notes Improver would watch the ticket queue for DONE and REJECTED tickets and the merge gate, figure out why tickets got rejected or failed the gate, and send ideas to the Coordinator to schedule work.
text:
I've updated Notes Improver (`notes_improver`), still unconfirmed and never running. It now watches `gate.landed` (DONE), `changes.requested` (REJECTED) and `gate.rejected` and `gate.conflict` (merge gate failures). Each run reads those tickets, states the cause from the reviewer's or gate's own words, and proposes one idea to you first.

I did not give it an event that sends work straight to the Coordinator. It proposes to you first, then sends the approved idea. Say if you want it to send ideas to the Coordinator without asking you first.

steps: 1. Once a day at its scheduled time, read the Notes Files stock and how many notes files were added in the last day.
2. Compare with the previous days and decide whether one change could raise the daily count.
3. If so, propose it to the owner for approval; once approved, hand it to the Coordinator as work with the Notes Files stock as its measure.
